name: React Bits Pro Roadmap
summary: Public roadmap of React Bits Pro: what shipped and what is planned across components, blocks, templates and agent skills.
description: Month-by-month roadmap from the February launch: counts of components, marketing blocks, app UI blocks, templates and agent-kit items shipped, plus planned work such as the Bento Builder and new agent skills. A single lifetime purchase covers everything on the roadmap.
contains: shipped so far: 230 components, 300 blocks, 15 templates, 20 agent-kit items
September: 42 bento tiles, 16 components, 4 templates, the Bento Builder
November plan: 15 agent skills, 2 templates, 20 components, 50 marketing blocks
